## Definition
Let $G$ be a graph with $n$ vertices and $m$ edges, and let $d_i$ denote the degree of the vertex $v_i$. Then the ***degree matrix*** of $G$ is the $n \times n$ matrix $D$ whose entries are given by

$$D_{ij} = \begin{cases} d_i & \text{if } i = j \\ 0 & \text{if } i \neq j \end{cases}$$
